studies.title: The turkey
studies.caption: A wild turkey moves through open woodland, its bronze feathers catching the light. Domesticated turkeys became one of the American animals carried across the Atlantic.
studies.prompt: Full-body three-quarter view of one wild male Meleagris gallopavo walking calmly in Mexican oak woodland, bronze-brown layered feathers, modest red wattle, bare bluish head, tail partly spread but not huge display. Two anatomically sound feet on leaf litter, no white industrial turkey, no humans.
